# **Coded CPAT** {.unnumbered}

Coded CPAT is the Python model of CPAT, the World Bank-IMF Climate Policy Assessment Tool. It reproduces the Excel-AI prototypes (the mitigation prototype and the distribution module) number for number, and it is written to be read: one small function per equation, named with the codes the Excel models use.

**How to read this book.** Part I is what you need to know, short enough to read before you start: how to run the model, where the data are and in what format, how scenarios and results work, how to edit the model and how to test it. Part II explains how the model works. The appendices hold the complete reference material (every equation, table, input, variable and rule); most of them are generated from the code and data, so they stay current.

| If you want to | Read |
|---|---|
| Run the model | [Quick start](01_Quick_start.qmd) |
| Know where the data are and what they look like | [The database](02_Database.qmd) |
| Define your own scenarios | [Scenarios and inputs](03_Scenarios.qmd) |
| Find a number in the results | [Results](04_Results.qmd) |
| Change or extend the model | [Editing the model](05_Editing.qmd), then [Architecture](07_Architecture.qmd) |
| Check that the model still matches Excel-AI | [Testing](06_Testing.qmd) |

*Version `0.9.2p0.1` (replicates Excel-AI 0.9.2 and Distribution 0.1.4). This book is generated from `coded/cpat_documentation/guide/` and the code and data (`docs/CPAT_coded_documentation_qmd/make_qmd.py`): edit those, never the generated chapters.*
